newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel diffs near steady in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel diffs near steady in lackluster trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials hovered near steady Tuesday despite the lackluster trading activity.
But NYMEX May heating oil futures, the basis price for jet fuel, slipped 0.23 cent by the close of trading.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 4.10 cent over the print, up 0.10 cent on the day, though no deals were seen done there.
USG 54-grade for delivery on the front 11th cycle on the Colonial Pipeline was offered at 1.75 cents over the screen, while back 11th cycle barrels were seen at 1.60 cents over.
